title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30173: add integration events to Sales Line Discounts page
summary: Two integration events are added to the Sales Line Discounts page to allow extensions to customize record filtering and resolve filter descriptions for item type values without modifying base code.
key_points: OnSetRecFiltersOnBeforeCurrPageUpdate is raised in SetRecFilters before CurrPage.Update so subscribers can add filters
That event uses IncludeSender = true, matching existing events on the page
OnGetFilterDescriptionCaseElse is raised from a new else branch in GetFilterDescription for item type values other than Item and Item Discount Group
Event parameters use the page's ItemTypeFilter option type; the requested enum does not exist yet
